name: West Nile Virus Neuroinvasive Disease Forecasting Challenge
description: Evaluates predictive skill of models forecasting West Nile virus neuroinvasive disease incidence across time and locations using an open forecasting challenge.
reputation: Well-regarded within the epidemiological forecasting community and used by public-health modelers in challenge settings, but specialized to vector-borne disease forecasting.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; limited historical samples per location and temporal/spatial heterogeneity can complicate evaluation; forecasts are evaluated probabilistically (e.g., CRPS/WIS), so point-accuracy metrics are insufficient.
